description: She wears a navy floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow sleeves and tan-gold embroidered borders at the neck, cuffs, front and hem. A decorated belt with round fittings secures the waist. A grey-cream fringed wrap with blue woven patterns rests along the forearms; brown leather shoes show beneath the hem. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
